chapter_note: Chapter teaches the doctrine of three "letters/epistles": (1) Calling from Living Spirit to the molding of man, (2) Answer from molding of man to Living Spirit, (3) Mind of Light from Christ Beloved to the holy Church. The first two iterations are cosmic substrate (Living Spirit ↔ First Man / molding of man). The third iteration is the classic editorial extension — applying the cosmic letter pattern to the editor's institution (holy Church, apocalypses, Wisdom). The editorial fatigue score (cosmological 4.8→0.0; ecclesial 0.0→12.8) confirms the structural pattern: substrate dominates first half, ecclesial extension dominates second half. Heavy manuscript damage (83.7%) limits certainty on many fragmentary lines. The opening Q&A frame is too damaged to extract substantive content.
